"import cadquery as cq

# Build the sketch on the YZ plane.
# Local (u, v) coordinates map to global (x, y, z) = (0, u, v).
P = cq.Plane.named("YZ")

# Local sketch coordinates (u, v) for the 8 vertices, in order.
local_vertices = [
    (  3.520908, -10.571057),
    ( 15.692446,   3.186364),
    ( 14.571057,  21.520908),
    (  0.813636,  33.692446),
    (-17.520908,  32.571057),
    (-29.692446,  18.813636),
    (-28.571057,   0.479092),
    (-14.813636, -11.692446),
]

# Create exactly 8 line edges connecting consecutive vertices (closed loop).
edges = []
n = len(local_vertices)
for i in range(n):
    p1 = P.toWorldCoords(local_vertices[i])
    p2 = P.toWorldCoords(local_vertices[(i + 1) % n])
    edges.append(cq.Edge.makeLine(p1, p2))

# Export the compound of edges to sketch.step.
cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
